title: F20 Fabulous One Eau De Parfum

details.description:
Fogg F20 Fabulous One Luxury Unisex Perfume Eau De Parfum is a refreshing and elegant fragrance designed for both men and women. The scent opens with bright and uplifting top notes of Bergamot, Mandarin and Orange, enhanced with a subtle hint of Nutmeg that adds a warm and slightly spicy touch.
The heart reveals a refined blend of Sea Air, Damask Rose, Jasmine, Lily and Orange Blossom, creating a clean and airy floral character that feels fresh and sophisticated.
The fragrance settles into a smooth base of Musk and Sandalwood, giving it a clean, warm and long-lasting finish that remains noticeable throughout the day.
Formulated with more than 20% superfine perfume oil, this Eau De Parfum offers a strong and enduring fragrance experience that keeps you feeling fresh and confident for hours. The balanced composition of citrus, floral and woody notes makes it suitable for daily wear as well as special occasions.
details.usageInstructions: Spray 15 cm away from body or clothes, avoiding eye contact.

title: F20 Fabulous Power Eau De Parfum

details.description:
Fogg F20 Fabulous Power Luxury Unisex Perfume Eau De Parfum is a refined fragrance crafted for both men and women. The scent opens with vibrant top notes of Orange, Ginger and Bergamot, creating a fresh and energetic introduction.
At the heart, elegant floral notes of Rose and Violet add a soft and sophisticated character to the fragrance. The base unfolds with warm and lasting notes of Amber, Vetiver and Musk, giving the perfume a rich, smooth and memorable finish.
Formulated with more than 20% superfine perfume oil, this Eau De Parfum offers a strong and long-lasting fragrance that stays noticeable throughout the day. The balanced blend of citrus, floral and woody notes makes it suitable for everyday wear as well as special occasions.
